description:
New component file returning a proper %VFlow{} tree — no %VLines{} wrapper needed. Replaces render_resource_sections/3 and helpers in interactive.ex.

File: apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/loaded_resources.ex

Spec: render(map() | nil, boolean(), RenderContext.t()) :: VDOM.t()
- nil → %VDOM.VFlow{children: []}
- resources, expanded, ctx → %VFlow{children: sections interspersed with blank separators}

Each section: heading VText (Theme.fg :md_heading) + body VText items (Theme.fg :dim). Collapsed: comma-joined names on one line. Expanded: one VText per item.

Delete from interactive.ex: render_resource_sections/3, render_context_section/3, render_skills_section/3, render_prompts_section/3, section_header/2

Tests: nil → empty VFlow. Collapsed: heading + comma line. Expanded: heading + one VText per item. Multiple sections: blank separators. Paint to LineBuf and verify byte output matches previous [binary()] output.

comments.text: Superseded by the tui2 architecture decision in docs/tui-architecture.md. This ticket added a new component to octo_pi_tui's VDOM-based pipeline; that pipeline is being replaced by Filament-on-tui2 rather than refactored further. The corresponding component will be implemented as a Filament defcomponent in a slot under the opi-t3t epic. Closing without further work.

title: LoadedResources component — VNode tree
